projects.title: Hindi Music Mood Classification
projects.description:
• Created Hindi music corpus & analyzed lyrics to classify songs into moods
• Collected data with web crawler script using Selenium, Pillow, OCR (Python)
• Used Convolutional Neural Network & Naïve Bayes Classifier (Baseline) classification techniques

projects.title: Weather Forecast
projects.description:
• Developed a weather forecast iOS app (Objective-C/Xcode)
• Returned Quick, Hourly, and 7 Day Forecast in table format
• Features include: Facebook Feed Share and real time weather map overlay
• Used Facebook API, AERIS Weather API, Forecast IO, AWS, JSON
